## Definition in words

What the patient reports or the clinician observes, as distinct from the diagnosis it supports — dyspnea, fever, nausea. T184 only; adding T033 Finding would triple the category and fill it with `one` and `normal`.

A semantic-type partition of an anchored parent. The parent's boundary is validated; **the split within it is not adjudicated by any corpus**. Report the parent's metrics and label this as a refinement.
